_read_me: Copy to demo_config.json. Replace every REPLACE_WITH_* value with a real id from the live database (states.id, districts.id, skills.id). The generator never invents ids. Signal names, units and semantics follow the lowercase style used in source_capabilities; confirm them with the database owner before loading. Numbers below are demo shapes only and must never be used to choose official thresholds.
source_context: DEMO series for the SIH demo where source-backed district x skill history is shorter than 3 years. Ranges chosen for illustration only.
